parts.name: tan minifigure legs
parts.description: tan/beige LEGO minifigure legs (hip piece with two legs)

parts.name: light-blue printed torso
parts.description: light-blue printed LEGO minifigure torso with two yellow arms

parts.name: yellow minifigure head
parts.description: small round yellow cylinder with a printed face

steps.instruction: Place the tan minifigure legs on the table, then attach the light-blue printed torso to the top of the legs.
steps.check: torso is seated on the hip studs

rule.question: Is the blue LEGO minifigure torso attached to the tan legs, forming one connected minifigure body?

steps.instruction: Attach the yellow minifigure head to the top of the torso.
steps.check: head is seated on the neck stud

rule.question: Is the yellow LEGO minifigure head attached on top of the blue torso?

steps.instruction: Place the orange hairpiece on top of the head.
steps.check: hairpiece covers the top of the head

rule.question: Is the orange LEGO hair piece attached on top of the yellow minifigure head?
